subject: Redwood Dedicated: Activation cadence & regional preference
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Dedicated: Activation cadence & regional preference

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, the next step for Acadia is the Dedicated GPU pool activation. To make this fast and low-friction I sketched a short cadence and a couple of decisions we need from you:

1) Region: do you want the primary pool in us-west-2 (lower latency for West Coast clinics) or us-east-1 (better cost / available burst capacity)?
2) Peak sizing: we populated a starting recommendation in the attached capacity_template.csv — can you confirm the expected concurrent sessions at T+30 days?
3) Procurement path: we can proceed via standard SOW + DocuSign (attached SOW v1.2) or slide into your existing marketplace contract. Which do you prefer?

Proposed cadence:
- Week 0: sign SOW / countersign DocuSign
- Week 1: capacity provisioning and networking handoff (netops contact)
- Week 2: smoke tests + canary traffic
- Week 3: go-live (ramp to prod traffic)

I've CC'd Monica (CS lead) and Ben (ops) so we can align timelines; Monica will own the implementation checklist and Ben will kick off capacity allocation once region + sizing are confirmed.

Attachments: Acadia_SOW_v1.2.pdf, capacity_template.csv

Looking forward — can you reply with region + a quick thumbs on procurement?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acadiahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acadia Onboarding <onboarding@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated: Activation cadence & regional preference

Sean —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Region: prefer us-east-1 for now (majority of our traffic originates from our East Coast data centers and we want the cheaper burst headroom you mentioned).
- Concurrent sessions at T+30: estimate 180 concurrent inference sessions (we'll confirm with infra team but that's a conservative baseline).
- Procurement: let's do the standard SOW + DocuSign flow. Legal will need a 3 business day review window.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you share the expected latency at 180 concurrency (p95) and any recommended batching settings?
- We need logs retention and audit configuration details for our security team.

Elena
Elena Ruiz
VP Product, Acadia Health
elena.ruiz@acadiahealth.com
Phone: +1 (617) 555-0189
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated: Activation cadence & regional preference

Team —

Looping internal ops and provisioning to translate Elena's answers into a concrete plan. Action items I'm taking now:
- Ben: please validate capacity_template.csv against our us-east-1 availability and give an estimated GPU count and queue sizing. Include burst headroom and a recommended autoscale policy (target and max).
- Priyom: can you prepare the audit/logs retention blurb (SOC2-aligned, retention windows, and where logs are stored) for Elena's security team?
- Sean: I will own the SOW execution and keep legal in the loop for a 3-business-day review. I'll also schedule a kickoff call for Thursday 08/27 — 11:00am ET; if that works I'll send the invite.

I've attached the capacity_template.csv filled with Elena's 180 concurrency baseline and a conservative 2x burst factor.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated: Activation cadence & regional preference

Monica / team —

Validated against inventory: us-east-1 has available r5/gpu clusters to meet an initial footprint of 6 A100-equivalent GPUs for the 180 concurrent baseline with room for bursts up to 12 GPUs. Notes:
- Recommended autoscale policy: target concurrency per GPU = 30 sessions (target keep 6 GPUs), max = 12 GPUs, cool-down = 120s. This gives ~2x burst headroom, consistent with Monica's 2x factor in the template.
- Expected p95 latency at 180 concurrency (default batching): ~230-300ms for short chat requests (<=512 tokens). We can tune batching to trade latency vs cost — estimate +15-30% latency reduction with small batching windows, or +/- cost depending on effective token throughput.
- Networking: need a netops contact from Acadia for VPC peering config and IP allowlist. I can provide a template for routing/NAT and recommended security group rules.

Attachments: capacity_template.csv (updated), provisioning-checklist.md (stub)

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated: Activation cadence & regional preference

Elena —

Thanks for the quick responses and the signposts. To summarize and next steps:

Decisions confirmed
- Primary region: us-east-1
- T+30 concurrency baseline: 180 (we'll treat 360 as burst cap)
- Procurement: SOW + DocuSign (we've attached v1.2 and prepared the DocuSign link)

Internal next steps (owners & timeline)
- Monica: initiate SOW routing today; expect countersign by Tue 08/31 given 3-business-day legal review.
- Ben: start provisioning request for 6 GPUs in us-east-1 and prepare the autoscale rule (target=30/session per GPU, max=12 GPUs). Please attach expected IP ranges to the provisioning ticket.
- Priyom: send a short SOC2/logs summary by EOD tomorrow for Acadia security review.

External asks for Acadia
- Please share your netops contact for VPC peering and confirm whether you prefer a dedicated subnet or shared egress NAT.
- Legal: expect the DocuSign link (docsign_acadia_sow.link) in a separate email shortly.

If that all looks good I will lock the kickoff call for Thu 08/27 11:00am ET and send calendar invites with the provisioning checklist and the DocuSign link.

Onwards — we should be in a good place to smoke test next week.

Best,
Sean
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
